20261121-chemistry-h1-1.title: zvichibva pakuendeswa kwema electron
20261121-chemistry-h1-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye zvichibva pakuendeswa kwema electron kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-chemistry-h1-1.material: Ndeipi tsananguro chaiyo ye 'oxidation' ne 'reduction' mukemisitiri yemazuva ano, zvichibva pakuendeswa kwema electron?
20261121-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi tsananguro chaiyo ye 'oxidation' ne 'reduction' mukemisitiri yemazuva ano, zvichibva pakuendeswa kwema electron?
20261121-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Maererano nekuendeswa kwema electron, kana chinhu chichirasikirwa nema electron chinonzi 'chinoita oxidized', uye kana chichiwana ma electron chinonzi 'chinoita reduced'. Nokuti chimwe chinhu chinowana ma electron akawanda sezvaarasika, oxidation ne reduction zvinogara zvichiitika pamwe chete.

20261121-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Kurasikirwa nema electron ndiko oxidation; kuwana ma electron ndiko reduction.

20261121-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.o.o1: Oxidation i reaction umo ma electron anowanikwa, uye reduction i reaction umo ma electron anorasika

20261121-chemistry-h1-2.title: Ndiko kudii kuchengetedza kunonzi
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Ndiko kudii kuchengetedza kunonzi kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.material: Ndiko kudii kuchengetedza kunonzi 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode method)', umo zvimedu zve zinc (Zn) kana magnesium (Mg) zvinobatanidzwa kumabhiriji kana zvikepe zvakagadzirwa nesimbi (Fe) kuti zvirege ku rust?
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Ndiko kudii kuchengetedza kunonzi 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode method)', umo zvimedu zve zinc (Zn) kana magnesium (Mg) zvinobatanidzwa kumabhiriji kana zvikepe zvakagadzirwa nesimbi (Fe) kuti zvirege ku rust?
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.explain: Kana zinc kana magnesium, zvinoita oxidized nyore kupfuura simbi (zvine ionization tendency huru), zvakabatanidzwa nayo, zinc inorasikirwa nema electron panzvimbo yayo uye ichiora (inoita oxidized), ichipa ma electron kusimbi nguva dzose, nokudaro ichidzivirira simbi kuti irege kuora kubva pakutanga.
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: Tendency yemetal yekuita ionize: Mg > Zn > Fe > Cu
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: Metal ine reactivity yakakura inorasikirwa nema electron pakutanga uye inopirwa.
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.o.o0: Zinc, ine reactivity yakakura kupfuura simbi (ine tendency huru yekuita ionize), inoita oxidized pakutanga panzvimbo yesimbi uye inopa ma electron kusimbi
20261121-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.o.o1: Zinc inokoneka kuzvenguruka simbi uye inovharira mhepo zvachose

20261122-chemistry-h1-1.title: Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.material: [Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro] Pakati pemamolecule anoumbwa nema nonmetal elements ega 2 anozadzisa octet rule (ma electron 8 eparutivi rwekunze), ndeipi sarudzo inoronga nemazvo nhamba yemapeya ema electron akagoverwa (bonding) neasina kugoverwa (lone) emethane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃), nemvura (H₂O)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro] Pakati pemamolecule anoumbwa nema nonmetal elements ega 2 anozadzisa octet rule (ma electron 8 eparutivi rwekunze), ndeipi sarudzo inoronga nemazvo nhamba yemapeya ema electron akagoverwa (bonding) neasina kugoverwa (lone) emethane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃), nemvura (H₂O)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Methane ($\text{CH}_4$) ine mapeya akagoverwa $4$ uye ma lone pair $0$. Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$), nekuda kwemaitiro enitrojeni, ine mapeya akagoverwa $3$ uye lone pair $1$, uye mvura ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) ine mapeya akagoverwa $2$ uye ma lone pair $2$.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Carbon (C) ine ma valence electron 4 uye inoita covalent bonds nemaatomu ose 4 ehaidrojeni.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Nitrojeni (N) inogovera 3 yema 5 ayo uye mamwe 2 anoita lone pair 1. Oksijeni (O) inogovera 2 yema 6 ayo uye mamwe 4 anoita ma lone pair 2.
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.o.o0: CH₄: akagoverwa 4, lone 0 / NH₃: akagoverwa 3, lone 1 / H₂O: akagoverwa 2, lone 2
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.o.o1: CH₄: akagoverwa 4, lone 4 / NH₃: akagoverwa 3, lone 2 / H₂O: akagoverwa 2, lone 0
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.o.o2: CH₄: akagoverwa 2, lone 2 / NH₃: akagoverwa 3, lone 0 / H₂O: akagoverwa 4, lone 1
20261122-chemistry-h1-1.s.s1.o.o3: Mamolecule ose matatu akafanana, ane mapeya 4 akagoverwa

20261122-chemistry-h1-2.title: Ndeupi dambudziko renharaunda rinokonzerwa
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Ndeupi dambudziko renharaunda rinokonzerwa kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.material: Ndeupi dambudziko renharaunda rinokonzerwa kana sulfur dioxide (SO₂) kana nitrogen oxides (NOx) zvinoburitswa nekupiswa kwemafuta ekare zvichipindura nemhute yemvura mumhepo kuita sulfuric acid kana nitric acid, zvichidzikisa pH yemvura inonaya pasi pehuwandu hwakajairika (inenge 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Ndeupi dambudziko renharaunda rinokonzerwa kana sulfur dioxide (SO₂) kana nitrogen oxides (NOx) zvinoburitswa nekupiswa kwemafuta ekare zvichipindura nemhute yemvura mumhepo kuita sulfuric acid kana nitric acid, zvichidzikisa pH yemvura inonaya pasi pehuwandu hwakajairika (inenge 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.explain: Sulfur oxides ne nitrogen oxides zvinopindura nemvura mumhepo zvichiumba ma strong acid sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) ne nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), zvinounza mvura inonaya ine acid yakasimba ine $\text{pH} < 5.6$ inoita kuti ivhu nemadziva zvive acidic.
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: Kana nonmetal oxides mumhepo dzichinyungudika mumvura, dzinoita acidic.
20261122-chemistry-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: Zvinoreva mvura inonaya ine pH yakaderera pane 5.6.
